summary_en: NXC Corporation acquired 118,527,140 shares held by subsidiary NXMH B.V. through share purchase (not tender offer). NXC's voting share increased from 31.40% to 46.38%; NXMH's stake reduced from 14.99% to 0.01%, moving it off major shareholder list. Transaction qualifies as regulated block acquisition under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Article 30 §1 ¶4. No impact on management or results anticipated.
title_en: Notice regarding change in major shareholders and acquisition of NEXON shares (share purchase constituting a regulated block acquisition under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Article 30)
translation_en_brief: On 19 June 2026, NEXON disclosed that NXC Corporation acquired 118,527,140 shares held by NXMH B.V., a subsidiary of NXC. The transaction was executed via direct share purchase (not a public tender offer) and qualifies as a regulated block acquisition under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Article 30 §1 ¶4 because it involves a voting stake exceeding 5%. NXC's voting shareholding rose from 31.40% (248,462,800 shares) to 46.38% (366,989,940 shares), consolidating its position as largest shareholder. NXMH B.V.'s stake fell from 14.99% to 0.01%, removing it from the major shareholders list. The company stated that the transaction has no impact on management or financial results. The disclosure serves both as a TSE listing-rule update and as the regulatory public notice required under the Ordinance Article 30.
